extras: Desktop-only plugin; best-tested on macOS; includes dependency install wizard.
intentEvidence: Desktop-only Obsidian plugin for importing external files into your vault and converting them into Markdown.
problem: Users often struggle to import and convert diverse external file formats (like DOCX, PDF, or EPUB) into a usable Markdown format within Obsidian.

summary: Smart Import is a desktop-only plugin that imports external files and converts them into Markdown notes while preserving original source assets.
